visual.name: TimeIntelligenceVisual
visual.description: Advanced bar/column chart with interactive time period & comparison dropdowns, error bars with % change, overlapping/side-by-side comparison bars, trend lines, moving averages, YTD, CAGR, and full native-style formatting options.

en-US.Visual_DataRole_DateField_Description: Date field for time intelligence grouping

dataRoles.name: dateField
dataRoles.description: Date field for time intelligence grouping

overlapPercent.description: How much the previous period bar overlaps (0-100)

barSpacing.description: Space between bar groups as percentage (5-80)

barWidthPercent.description: Width of bars within each group (20-100)

dropdownOptionsFontSize.description: Font size of dropdown option items when expanded

showYearFilter.description: Auto-shown when period < Yearly. Set to false to always hide.

showQuarterFilter.description: Auto-shown when period < Quarterly. Set to false to always hide.

showMonthFilter.description: Auto-shown when period is Daily or Weekly. Set to false to always hide.

value2Label.description: Legend label for the second measure (dual measure mode only)

value2Style.description: Style settings for the second measure bar (dual measure mode only)

showTotalChange.description: Shows overall % increase/decrease when comparison is active

highlightColor.description: Color for period names and key values

valueDecimalPlaces.description: Decimal places for numeric values in tooltip (0-6)

percentDecimalPlaces.description: Decimal places for percentage values in tooltip (0-4)

stagger.description: Animate bars one after another with a delay

enableDataSampling.description: Sample data when dataset is very large (>10k rows)

maxDataPoints.description: Maximum number of data points to process

showPerformanceWarning.description: Display warning when dataset is large

autoDisableAnimationThreshold.description: Disable animations when bar count exceeds this (0 = never)

enableSmartAggregation.description: Auto-aggregate to reduce data points when needed
